messages:
anya: Tempesta11b int8 canary is OOMing on longer generations and small batches >1. Repro locally on canary-3, looks like KV allocation spike around token 1200. Logs below.

mike: Can you paste the exact error? is it CUDA OOM or our runtime eviction failure?

anya: CUDA OOM from alloc_tensor, stack: runtime/kv_cache.c:evict_slots -> alloc_chunk. Example snippet:```
[2026-03-21 09:14:22] ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
... alloc size=1.2GiB, free=900MiB, kv_slots=384
```

rachel: hmm. Model was quantized with our int8 pipeline but we left prefetch=true and default max_new_tokens=512 for onboard. That combination explodes the working set for multi-turns.

jordan: +1. I saw fragmentation on int8 variants before when prefetching large prefix + long generation. Try disabling prefetch or lowering max_new_tokens.

lee: Quick triage: repro steps? payload and config?

anya: Repro: prompt ~1.2k tokens, request max_new_tokens=512, batch_size=2, prefetch=true, quant=int8, kernel=auto. Happens ~30% of runs.

mike: For immediate mitigation set batch_size=1 and max_new_tokens=256 in canary policy. Also set kv_eviction_threshold=0.7 to be more aggressive.

rachel: Agree. Also measure quality delta when we reduce to int8+256. I ran a quick QA micro-bench on 200 samples:
- fp16 baseline (batch=2, max_new=512): EM=78.2, F1=84.6
- int8 same config: EM=77.6, F1=83.9 (drop ~0.7 F1)
- int8 + max_new=256: EM=77.7, F1=84.0
So quality loss is minor with smaller max_new.

jordan: Good. So plan: revert default model metadata for Tempesta11b-canary to: `batch_size:1`, `max_new_tokens:256`, `prefetch:false`, `kv_eviction_threshold:0.7`. We can keep int8 but add a note: "avoid prefetch for long prompts / high max_new_tokens"

lee: For longer term, we should test an alternative quant recipe (per-channel scale clipping) — int8 seems OK but fragment-prone on our allocator. Try a run with `compact_kv=true` and `kv_trim_on_alloc=true` to reduce fragmentation.

anya: I'll run a 1k-sample QA/SMOKE suite with those flags. Patch I'm going to try:```yaml
model: tempesta11b-int8
runtime: redwood-runtime-v2
batch_size: 1
max_new_tokens: 256
prefetch: false
compact_kv: true
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.7
kv_trim_on_alloc: true
```

ci-bot: Canary deploy tempesta11b-int8 updated config queued (run id: canary-20260321-88). Tests will run and post status. :robot_face:

mike: Cool. If that stabilizes, we should also add a per-model onboarding checklist item: "run frag stress (long prompt + batch 2..4) and record peak CUDA alloc" and add a gating rule that int8 on Tempesta must pass frag test before batch>1 allowed.

rachel: Also log quality delta across standard eval sets (QA, summarization) and attach to model metadata so Console can show recommended defaults + known regressions.

anya: Update: first 50 runs with compact_kv + kv_trim_on_alloc passed, no OOMs so far. We'll wait for full smoke.

lee: Thanks. Action items summarized: anya run full suite + post numbers, mike update canary policy defaults, rachel add eval artifacts to model card, jordan open an infra ticket for allocator fragmentation metrics.

mike: I'll also add a temporary alert on canary nodes for CUDA mem > 18Gi to catch regressions early. :bell:

anya: Sounds good. Will post final results here once suite completes.

ci-bot: canary run canary-20260321-88 completed: 1200/1200 tests ok, 0 OOMs, avg latency +3% vs int8 baseline.

rachel: Nice. With those numbers I'm comfortable setting the onboarding defaults as proposed. I'll update the model card and onboarding PR after lunch. :slightly_smiling_face:

jordan: Thanks team. We'll close the thread once the PR is merged and the canary policy is live.
